Title: Angular Modernization + Zoneless
Body:
This is primarily code cleanup by switching the rest of the application to use signals and updating all FormGroups -> signal-based forms. In addition, we have removed Zone.JS. Please help us by doing shakeout and reporting bugs. Nearly 
every piece of code changed. 



# Changed
- Changed: Made carousel reels scroll better with laptop trackpads
- Changed: Added more context to search results and updated the search UX
- Changed: When you finish reading a series you've never read/rated before, Kavita will now prompt you to rate/review then redirect you to the series-detail page. (Currently only manga reader implemented).
- Changed: Edit Person modal cover db functionality it now inlined with the cover chooser
- Changed: (Manga Reader) When you are on Double and reader forces Single, if you gain more space, it will go back to Double layout.

# Fixed
- Fixed: Fixed a bug where hitting escape in a reader with shortcut modal open, would also collapse reader.
- Fixed: Edit reading list modal tag typeahead was broken
- Fixed: Do not allow default reading profile to be assign to series/libraries (Fixes #4919)
- Fixed: Fixed version service not respecting the backoff 

# Developer
- Updated the whole app to use signals (form signals/OnPush)
- Removed Zone.js 
- Updated accessibility for search and typeahead components
